traits.description:
This one climbed the tower to the top, and whatever was waiting up there did not send them back the way they came.

They are not stronger than they were, and they do not learn any faster. What changed is the body they came back in. The hair has gone white as fresh snow, the face somewhere past man or woman, and people who meet them forget what they were about to say.

It has stopped aging - not slowed, stopped, on the day they came down. Sickness will not take hold of it: plagues burn out, parasites starve, and the slow failures of old flesh simply never arrive. And it will not die. Wounds that would kill anyone else put it into a healing sleep instead, and it wakes up.

Nothing reaches the mind either. Grief, terror, the long grinding misery that breaks ordinary people - it arrives, and it finds nowhere to land. What did get through is the other direction: the psychic weather of the world is deafening to them now, and they have learned to stand inside it and use it.

There is one way to end them, and everyone who has thought about it for a minute has worked out what it is.

They do not talk about the hundredth floor.

- Does not age
- Immune to disease, infection, and the failures of old flesh
- Cannot die unless the brain is destroyed
- Never suffers a mental break, whatever is done to them
- Psychic sensitivity +1000%
- Beheld as angelic (+50 opinion from those who can see)
- Cannot be born with it. It is taken.

races.name: monkey

races.description: Engineered for chemicals production, the boomalope grows a large sac of volatile chemicals on its back. Though it is weak and fragile for its size, other animals have learned to avoid it because of the huge explosion it produces when it dies. It can be milked to produce chemfuel - very carefully.

races.description: A large, energetic dog with a thick fur coat for remaining comfortable in arctic environments.
races.name: husky

races.description: A large plant eating mammal appearing in the savannah wilderness. Tamed are quite docile, but enraged are fast and dangerous.
races.name: bison

races.description:
A great white bear adapted for frozen climates. Their thick blubber and fur keep them warm in winter.

While their usual diet consists of fish and scavenged meat, the polar bear can also use its massive strength and deadly claws to kill live prey. They are startlingly quick for such lumbering creatures.
races.name: polar bear

races.description:
A huge omnivorous mammal adapted for cold climates. Bears' thick blubber and fur keeps them warm in winter.

While their usual diet consists of fish, berries, honey, and scavenged meat, the grizzly is capable of using its massive strength and deadly claws to kill live prey. They are startlingly quick for such lumbering creatures.
races.name: grizzly bear

races.description:
A gigantic, graceful creature of unknown origin. The thrumbo is gentle by nature, but extremely dangerous when enraged. While its long fur is exceptionally beautiful, its hide is also incredibly resistant to damage. Its razor-sharp horn fetches a huge price.

Legends say that an old thrumbo is the wisest creature in the universe - it simply chooses not to speak.
races.name: thrumbo

races.description: A large flightless bird with beady eyes on its ugly face. With its bad attitude, it is the jerk of the natural world. Bother it, and it is guaranteed to seek revenge.
races.name: emu

races.description: A small solitary canine evolved for hunting small prey in temperate climates. Chicken farmers hate foxes because of their ability to destroy a whole coop in minutes.
races.name: red fox

races.description: The largest unmodified bird species, ostriches are known for their fast run, huge eggs, and powerful kick. It is easily angered.
races.name: ostrich

races.description: A rugged predator long feared by many ancient Earth cultures. As pack hunters, wolves have complex social lives and are fiercely intelligent.
races.name: timber wolf

races.description:
Even this lesser grade of vampire far exceeds a human’s capabilities. These monsters are quick, precise, and extraordinarily strong. They can demolish foes with their powerful melee attacks, and their bites also spread the curse of Ghoulism. They possess incredible passive regeneration which lets them shrug off all but the most extreme damage.

End these abominations by either overwhelming or disabling their regeneration.
Cursed Arms can accomplish the latter, and Holy Arms can do that and more.

Artificial Vampires are created by implanting a human with a FREAK Chip, and when they are sent to hell and butchered properly their corpses yield Congealed Soul Stones used in crafting.

Vampires find nourishment from a variety of sources. They can eat meat or corpses, or drink blood from medically-extracted Blood Pouches. They can also drink “from the tap” by using abilities on fleshy pawns.
races.name: Artificial Vampire

races.description:
True Vampires are, in every regard, far more powerful and resilient than their make-shift mockeries. Their bites naturally inflict a different type of Ghoulism. The Nosferatu is also capable of greatly expanding its power through devouring Ability Orbs and Ultimate BloodBreakers.

True Vampires are created when a human accepts Bewitched Blood which can be acquired at the end of the Hellsing ARMS Ultimate research tab, and after all of their souls have been defeated they may be butchered properly to yield a Scarlet Soul Orbs used in crafting.
races.name: True Vampire

races.description:
Ghouls vary based on their eye colour: orange, purple, and green. They are generally similar, but an important difference is their allegiance: orange only ally with other freaks, purple are controlled by Millennium, and green are naturally obedient to the Player. Whatever the colour, ghouls are mindless creatures which move as quickly as they recover damage, which is to say “very slowly.” They do not think and they do not feel pain. They aren’t bothered by the loss of blood or of most critical organs.

Be very careful when fighting ghouls. Better to dispatch them from range, as their bites inflict a terrible curse which will transform humans into ghouls. A cursed pawn has but one recourse: an operation treating their wounds with Holy Water.

The best way of dispatching ghouls, and undead in general, is to use Holy Arms. These blessed weapons inflict Searing Sanctification, a devastating debuff to creatures of darkness. When a ghoul is butchered, it yields Ghoul Dust which is used in crafting.
